multi_index_optimization.support_condition: This bound is valid for every finite support S subset of the retained primes; it uses a simultaneous perturbation budget, not a product of separate strips.

valid_weighted_l2.proof: Shift the selected finite torus coordinates to z_q=exp(i theta_q+s_q), apply Parseval on that shifted torus, and use the uniform response bound M_(j,R).
